map.酸性磷酸酶阳性就是精斑吗？: Is a positive acid phosphatase test proof of a seminal stain?
map.不是。前列腺液、阴道分泌液、植物过氧化物酶也可阳性，必须用 PSA/p30 特异: No. Prostatic fluid, vaginal secretions and plant peroxidases can also test positive, so a PSA/p30 specific confirmation is required to avoid false positives.
map.找不到精子就不算精斑吗？: Is a sample with no sperm not a seminal stain?
map.不算。结扎、不育、射精量少者常无精子，PSA/p30 特异蛋白阳性即可认定人精液: Not necessarily. Vasectomised, infertile or low-volume samples often contain no sperm, and a positive PSA/p30 specific protein result is enough to identify human semen; a negative microscopic exam does not overturn the conclusion.
